name: Analytics Dashboard
description: Data visualization, KPI tracking, and interactive charts

frontend.name: 01_header.txt
frontend.content: Create an analytics dashboard header with a date range picker (Last 7/30/90 days), export buttons (CSV/PDF), and a theme toggle.

frontend.name: 02_sidebar.txt
frontend.content: Create a sidebar with: Overview, Metrics, Funnels, Cohorts, Reports, Export. Use a minimal design with subtle icons.

frontend.name: 03_kpi_grid.txt
frontend.content: Create 6 KPI cards in a responsive grid: Sessions, Users, Bounce Rate, Conversion Rate, Revenue, Avg. Session Duration. Each card shows current value, previous period change, and a small sparkline.

frontend.name: 04_main_chart.txt
frontend.content: Create a large area chart showing traffic over time with a selectable metric. Include a secondary Y-axis for conversion rate. Use Chart.js with zoom/pan.

frontend.name: 05_geo_chart.txt
frontend.content: Create a world map visualization with traffic by country. Use simple color shading. Click a country to drill down.

frontend.name: 06_funnel.txt
frontend.content: Create a multi-step funnel visualization: Landing → Signup → Onboarding → Purchase → Retention. Show drop-off percentages between each stage.

frontend.name: 07_footer.txt
frontend.content: Create a footer with data source attribution, last-updated timestamp, and a 'Download Report' button.

backend.name: 01_server.txt
backend.content: Create an Express.js server with data aggregation endpoints: /api/analytics/sessions, /api/analytics/conversion, /api/analytics/funnel. Use dayjs for date handling.

backend.name: 02_database.txt
backend.content: Create a time-series-friendly schema: events table (user_id, event_type, timestamp, properties JSON), users table, sessions table. Include indexes for time-based queries.

backend.name: 03_routes.txt
backend.content: Create analytics API routes: POST /api/events (ingest), GET /api/analytics/overview (KPI summary), GET /api/analytics/timeseries (date-bucketed aggregation with filters).

backend.name: 04_cache.txt
backend.content: Add Redis caching layer for expensive aggregation queries. Cache key: 'analytics:<metric>:<dateRange>'. TTL: 5 minutes. Invalidate on new event ingestion in the same period.
